L6_not_analyzable_labels.rule: Each rank is analysed through analyze_rank_safe(). SystemExit from the strict run-dir / integrity checks (including >1 DONE dir after an accidental re-run = duplicate evidence) => verdict 'NOT ANALYZABLE (data integrity, not a null): ...'. Any other exception (KeyError, torch load, ...) => 'NOT ANALYZABLE (internal error, not a null): <type>: ...' instead of crashing the script and writing no rows. Either way the row has no p_IUT, so the other primary rank becomes INCOMPLETE (never PASS); neither string can be read as a null result.
